proposal.name: Lovinčićeva – volumeni iz lokacijske dozvole
proposal.title: Lovinčićeva – volumeni iz lokacijske dozvole
proposal.description: Radna rekonstrukcija 12 nadzemnih volumena A–E3 na k.č. 4090/1, k.o. Peščenica, za usporedbu alternativnog urbanog oblika. Položaji su preuzeti iz službenih ISPU geometrija lokacijske dozvole, uz B3 iz građevinske dozvole; etažnost i stanovi iz dozvole. Nacrtana geometrija daje približno 10.348 m² tlocrta, 33,0% izgrađenosti, 90.977 m² nadzemnog GBP-a i kin 2,904. Lokacijska dozvola navodi 11.519 m² tlocrta, 36,8%, 90.603 m² nadzemnog GBP-a, kin 2,9 i 1.370 stanova.
proposal.author: zagreb.lol – lokalna analiza

source.coordinateSystem: HTRS96/TM (EPSG:3765), transformed to WGS84 for the app

registration.basis: Uniform scale from the published C1 basement strip to the oriented C1 footprint; the connected CG/C2 garage extends east within the same drawing.
registration.note: This residual measures outline fit, not surveyed positional accuracy. Balconies and later design changes can differ from the permit footprint.

notes: Published shared C1/CG/C2 basement, owned once by C1.
Catalogue clear parking height is about 2.80 m; the 3 m storey and 0.20 m slab are estimates.
Walls and doors come from vector outlines. Stair enclosures are drawn but treads are not provided; no stair run is invented.
Above-ground floors have no recovered whole-floor source and retain the original display volume.
